messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Evaluate+Optimize playbook for the Q2 roadmap review. Primary asks: prompt-set baseline + guard rails, regression gating thresholds, and batching/KV caching recommendations for cost SLOs. Who can own which piece?

jason (ML Eng): I can own batching/KV cache recommendations. Need target perf numbers and the regression thresholds we'll gate on. @maria?

maria (PM): Target: p95 latency <= 120ms for 512-token requests on Dedicated, and ~20% cost reduction vs current baseline. Regression gating: automatic block if core-suite quality drops > 3%.

eva (Research): For prompt sets I propose 3 tiers: smoke (50 prompts), core (500 prompts), adversarial (200 prompts). Each tier has pass/fail thresholds and sampling rules. Use a mix of embedding-sim and a small human-labeled calibration set.

rebecca (DevEx): Recommend stable JSONL schema: {id, input, expected_output, tags}. Also add an eval manifest with thresholds. Example runner:```rwd-eval run --suite core --model redwood-1.1 --metrics sim,bert_score,human```

kevin (Infra): Note on batching: larger batch sizes improve throughput but increase tail latency during spikes. We need canary windows and a dynamic fallback to smaller batch sizes. Suggest canary: 5% traffic for 24h with automated rollback hooks.

sam (ProdEng): Gating suggestions: smoke must be green (0 regressions) before any canary. Core allows up to 1% degradation during canary with manual review; >3% triggers immediate rollback. Also surface a single 'quality_score' in Console for quick triage.

maria (PM): Owners: jason -> batching/KV config; eva -> prompt sets; rebecca -> eval tooling/schema; kevin -> canary infra & fallback; sam -> gating automation. Tentative milestones: M1 prototypes (2w), M2 canary (4w), M3 GA (8-10w). Is that feasible?

jason (ML Eng): M1 is doable in 2w if we reuse current batching runtime. I'll need eva's prompt sets and a perf harness.

eva (Research): I'll produce smoke + core prompt sets next week, adversarial suite in 3 weeks. Will provide 100 human labels for core calibration.

rebecca (DevEx): I'll extend rwd-eval to support tags and threshold-driven CI gating. ETA ~2w. Will add output that writes a single quality_score number.

kevin (Infra): I'll prepare the canary pipeline and fallback policy. Need explicit approval for 5% traffic route in Dedicated. Also need a short list of alert thresholds to wire into ops channels.

maria (PM): Approved: 5% canary on Dedicated. Requirement: notify Dedicated customers before canary. Add SLA notes in roadmap doc. Rollback triggers: reg delta > 3% on core OR p95 latency > 200ms sustained 15m OR error rate > 0.5%.

sam (ProdEng): Clarifying — automated rollback condition is any single trigger OR a combination? e.g., a 2% reg drop + p95>180ms for 30m should it rollback?

maria (PM): Rollback is OR across triggers. If anything crosses threshold we auto-fail the canary and trigger rollback; ops may then start an investigation.

eval-bot: automated-run: core-suite completed; quality-delta=+0.2%; sim-score unchanged.

maria (PM): Nice. Next steps: owners confirm dates here, rebecca create GH issue for eval schema, jason add perf harness PR, kevin start canary infra work. I'll slot this into the Friday roadmap review. :thumbsup:

rebecca (DevEx): GH issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize/issues/4521 — schema and CI hooks tracked.

jason (ML Eng): Perf harness PR incoming later today.

maria (PM): Thanks everyone — will update roadmap doc and send invites for a short sync tomorrow if needed.
